tools.name: wickedapi_price
tools.description:
Get the current price for a symbol (crypto or stock) from WickedAPI.

    Args:
        symbol: e.g. BTC, ETH, SUI, NVDA, SPY.
        asset_class: "stock" or "crypto" — required for symbols outside the
            curated list, optional otherwise.

tools.name: wickedapi_momentum
tools.description:
Get WickedAPI's momentum score for a symbol.

    Args:
        symbol: One of BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, NVDA, IBIT, COIN, QQQ, TQQQ, DIA.
        timeframe: One of 15m, 1h, 4h, 1D, 1W. Defaults to 1h.

tools.name: wickedapi_funding_oi
tools.description:
Get perpetual-futures funding rate and open interest for a crypto symbol.

    Args:
        symbol: Base crypto symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL — mapped to the
            <SYMBOL>USDT perpetual on Binance/Bybit.

tools.name: reputation_tiers

tools.name: reputation_transparency

tools.name: registry_tool_detail

tools.name: registry_featured_tools

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: identity_get_nonce, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response, memory_prepare · Private data: reputation_status, reputation_statement, registry_report_tool, registry_register_tool, identity_get_nonce, identity_register, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response, identity_status, memory_prepare, memory_store, memory_search, memory_get, memory_update, memory_history, memory_delete, memory_deletions · Public sink: registry_register_tool, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response · Destructive: identity_status, sanity_check, sanity_check_batch, memory_prepare, memory_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: identity_get_nonce, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response, memory_prepare · Private data: reputation_status, reputation_statement, registry_report_tool, registry_register_tool, identity_get_nonce, identity_register, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response, identity_status, memory_prepare, memory_store, memory_search, memory_get, memory_update, memory_history, memory_delete, memory_deletions · Public sink: registry_register_tool, identity_get_challenge, identity_submit_response · Destructive: identity_status, sanity_check, sanity_check_batch, memory_prepare, memory_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
